development_scope: existing previously studied development scenarios; four pilot seeds inspected before protocol
question: Can causal memory of every active call remove overlapping-window failure, and what capacity/schedule choices preserve the unchanged criteria?
controls: unchanged v0.20 MPC; same MPC with all observed windows; greedy plus identical all-window guard at f10/H8G12
selection: largest tested fraction passing one-sided 95% Wilson lower >= .95 on 100 development seeds; retain none if none
confirmation_plan: every case/program/controller tests development selection, or prespecified full original single offer if none; H8G12 additionally always tests full offer for both MPC controllers; f10/H8G12 greedy full-offer comparator; no reselection on confirmation
primary_contrast: paired original versus all-window MPC at full original offer, H8G12, f10; all five cases reported
diagnostics: failure-family counts; missing all-window guard at baseline peak; queue/deadline exposure; success without individual criterion reported only as diagnostic, never qualification
schedule_confound: changing gap changes clock alignment as well as recovery time; no pure gap-duration causation claimed
family_inference: pointwise Wilson bounds per prespecified offer; primary paired whole-seed bootstrap 10000; all contrasts reported, no simultaneous guarantee
economics: all complete paired trajectories; same v0.20 prices and twelve independent four-call episodes/year; annual accounting is not continuous simulation
seed_isolation: 970000-970299 not examined before selection; development and confirmation not pooled
